answer: A garden carries each claim downstream once, so no answer can circle back and be counted twice. At every bend, a signal marks a checkpoint where the miner deposits a small time-locked stake, released only after five independent witnesses confirm the work. A reef grows beside the checkpoint as proof of honest passage; a second claim from the same identity withers it and forfeits the stake. Witnesses are drawn at random from separate regions, so neighbours cannot vouch for each other, and the stake doubles for repeat offenders, making Sybil farming unprofitable.
